title: Organocatalytic Synthesis and DNA Interactive Studies of New 1,2,3-triazolyl-thiazolidines Hybrids.
authors: Larroza, Allya; Soares, Liane K; Morais, Roberto B; Bach, Mariana F; Jacoby, Caroline G; Iglesias, Bernardo A; Schneider, Paulo Henrique; Alves, Diego
journal: Chembiochem : a European journal of chemical biology
one_liner_zh: 该文合成三唑-噻唑烷杂环化合物并通过光谱、黏度及分子对接研究其与DNA的相互作用，虽涉及蛋白-DNA互作体系但对象为小分子-DNA结合，非TF-DNA转录因子体系，且方法以实验为主、分子对接为辅，AI/物理模拟深度不足。
abstract: An organocatalytic [3+2] cycloaddition reaction between thiazolidine-containing beta-ketoester 1 and aryl azides 2 was employed to synthesize new 1,2,3-triazolyl-thiazolidine hybrids 3. In this metal-free approach, twelve compounds were isolated in yields ranging from 23 % to 96 % by using diethylamine (10 mol%) and DMSO at 75  degrees C for 24 hours. DNA-binding assays were conducted through absorption, emission spectroscopy and viscosimetry analysis, to evaluate the interaction capacity of the studied derivatives with nucleic acids. All the synthesized compounds were evaluated for their interactions with a specific group of compounds containing the pharmacophoric groups triazole and thiazolidine through a molecular docking speculative study, aimed at identifying the interaction profile of these compounds with DNA. The obtained results suggest that 1,2,3-triazolyl-thiazolidine hybrids could be a promising approach in the development of novel therapeutic agents targeting DNA-related processes.
abstract_zh: 采用含噻唑烷的β-酮酯1与芳基叠氮化物2之间的有机催化[3+2]环加成反应，合成了新型1,2,3-三唑基-噻唑烷杂合物3。在此无金属方法中，使用二乙胺（10 mol%）和二甲基亚砜（DMSO），在75摄氏度下反应24小时，分离得到12种化合物，产率范围为23%至96%。通过吸收光谱、发射光谱和粘度测定分析进行了DNA结合实验，以评估所研究衍生物与核酸的相互作用能力。所有合成的化合物通过分子对接推测性研究，评估了它们与含有药效团三唑和噻唑烷的特定化合物组的相互作用，旨在确定这些化合物与DNA的相互作用谱。所得结果表明，1,2,3-三唑基-噻唑烷杂合物可能成为开发靶向DNA相关过程的新型治疗剂的 promising 途径。
